verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Markers use first English-language book-publication years rather than composition or adaptation dates. The Hitchhiker's Guide began as a BBC radio series in 1978 and was reworked as a novel in 1979. Life, the Universe and Everything developed from an earlier Doctor Who film idea, and Dirk Gently's Holistic Detective Agency reused elements from earlier Doctor Who scripts. Radio and television scripts, games, co-written dictionaries and Last Chance to See (1990), a nonfiction collaboration with Mark Carwardine, are outside the novel-only span. Douglas Adams's Starship Titanic (1997) was written by Terry Jones from Adams's game and is excluded. The unfinished The Salmon of Doubt appeared posthumously in a 2002 collection and is excluded.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
